arguments: set -euo pipefail; state="$ANNEAL_STATE_DIR"; mkdir -p "$state/config"; if [ -f "$state/config/.env" ]; then ln -sfn "$state/config/.env" .env; elif [ -f .env.example ]; then cp .env.example "$state/config/.env"; chmod 600 "$state/config/.env"; ln -sfn "$state/config/.env" .env; elif [ -n "${GITHUB_READ_TOKEN:-}" ]; then npm run setup:local; mv .env "$state/config/.env"; chmod 600 "$state/config/.env"; ln -sfn "$state/config/.env" .env; else npm run setup:local; mv .env "$state/config/.env"; chmod 600 "$state/config/.env"; ln -sfn "$state/config/.env" .env; fi

set -euo pipefail; state="$ANNEAL_STATE_DIR"; project=coding-tools-anneal; export COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME="$project"; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; initialized="$state/database-v0.9.0.initialized"; initializing="$state/database-v0.9.0.initializing"; existing="$(docker volume ls --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=$project --filter label=com.docker.compose.volume=agentos_postgres_data -q)"; if [ -n "$existing" ] && [ ! -f "$initialized" ]; then echo 'Anneal dedicated database exists without a completed Coding Tools initialization marker; refusing a fresh reset.' >&2; exit 42; fi; if [ -z "$existing" ]; then mkdir -p "$state"; printf 'started\n' > "$initializing"; docker compose -p $project up -d --wait postgres; npm run db:migrate:release -- --fresh; printf 'complete\n' > "$initialized"; else docker compose -p $project up -d --wait postgres; fi
